summary: Iteration 34 - Expo SDK 54->57 upgrade regression PASSED. Backend: 8/8 pytest cases green (login 200 with access_token+user, /auth/me bearer 200, /properties non-empty list, /chat/conversations auth 200, POST chat message 200 + preview updated, google-session invalid -> 401, register-push malformed -> 422, unauthenticated /auth/me -> 401). Frontend web-preview regression: onboarding->/login redirect works; login screen renders 'Welcome back' with Google + Facebook buttons (Apple correctly hidden on web); email/password sign-in with demo@amass.africa/amass2026 lands on /(tabs) map; map-legend-chip present bottom-left; all 4 primary filter chips (For Sale / For Rent / Land / Commercial) render; legend modal opens on tap and shows all 8 property-type colours (Residential, Apartment, Estate, Land, Commercial, Industrial, Hospitality, Institutional) + Verified badge + Hot listing; icon-rendering clean (0 U+FFFD replacement chars, no '?' box placeholders on login/map/inbox/profile screens); Ionicons visible everywhere (heart on cards, chevrons in headers, chatbubble, search, mic, camera icons all rendering); /inbox loads without crash (5 conversations visible with data-testid='conv-*'); tapping a conversation navigates to /chat/{id} without runtime errors and renders full message thread (including the regression message our pytest just posted); /profile renders Ada Demo card + MASS balance + Admin Cockpit + Wallet menu items with icons. Zero critical console errors, zero pageerrors, zero 'Cannot find native module' overlays. No red-screen. Migration from @expo/vector-icons to @react-native-vector-icons/ionicons is fully working via the CDN webfont hook.
action_items: No fixes required. SDK 57 upgrade is regression-clean on both backend and web preview.

As previously noted, docked-card quick-actions and push send/voice record still need native (Expo Go / dev-client) verification; these are not testable on web preview and are not part of this upgrade regression.
critical_code_review_comments: use-icon-fonts.ts correctly points to the @react-native-vector-icons/ionicons CDN URL for web font injection - icons render across all tested screens.
mediaLibrary.ts wrapper approach (lazy import) successfully sidesteps the expo-media-library@57 web bug; no crash observed on any screen we exercised.
app.json cleanup (removed newArchEnabled / edgeToEdgeEnabled / expo-status-bar plugin) did not break Metro or supervisor - expo bundle is serving successfully.

Login form still lacks explicit data-testid on email/password/signin (had to fall back to input[type=email/password] + get_by_text). Minor testability gap - not a regression, but worth adding for future automation stability.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (all upgrade-regression checks green on web preview)
